items.html: And the matter is that there must be an arousal of the lower ones, like the manner of the lower coupling, to raise MAN; therefore one must intend in his prayer up to there, and then that Path will raise female waters to receive male waters; and this Path is not known, neither above nor below, neither in the secret of Mayin Nukvin nor in the secret of Mayin Dechurin. And the coupling is not complete except through this Path.
